welcome-display.purpose: Disconnected welcome only; stacked layout with viewport width at least 360 logical pixels.

welcome-display-narrow.purpose: Disconnected welcome only; stacked layout below 360 logical pixels of viewport width.

welcome-display-expanded.purpose: Disconnected welcome only; two-column layout when the welcome-expanded criterion is met.

motion.name: more-popup
motion.purpose: A vertical popup over the unchanged current branch: native fade and short vertical arrival, zero with reduced motion. Only its requested backdrop uses blur and dimming.

motion.name: top-navigation-selection
motion.purpose: The 2dp teal underline follows the selected destination; reduced motion uses zero duration.

motion.name: top-navigation-reveal
motion.purpose: Scrollable.ensureVisible reveals the selected menu item after selection or width changes; reduced motion uses zero duration.

motion.name: welcome-ledger-entrance
motion.purpose: One paint-only entrance for three native paths into the canonical P, without a loop or delaying the action. Reduced motion immediately settles at progress 1; the P is present from frame zero. Scoped to the disconnected welcome.

breakpoints.name: welcome-narrow-headline
breakpoints.value: viewport width < 360px in the stacked welcome
